children: FAYETTEVILLE, Ark., Sept. 09, 2026
-- Buffington Homes by Toll Brothers, a division of
, the nation’s leading builder of luxury homes, today announced its highly anticipated 2026 Luxury Home Tour taking place September 12 – 20, 2026 at new community locations across Northwest Arkansas.

The public is invited to tour select model homes Monday through Saturday between 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and on Sunday between 1 p.m. to 6 p.m. Complimentary sweet treats will be available throughout the tour, and complimentary bites from local food trucks will be offered every Saturday from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
This year’s Luxury Home Tour destinations include five model homes in communities in Fayetteville, Elm Springs, Rogers, and Bentonville, as well as the Fayetteville Design Studio:
Magnolia Park
offers beautiful new homes in west Fayetteville with convenient access to Clabber Creek Trail, Shaw Family Park, Interstate 49 and Highway 112.
Parkside
provides a peaceful Elm Springs setting near Shaw Family Park, combining quiet neighborhood living with easy access to everything Northwest Arkansas has to offer.
Evening Star
showcases elevated home designs in one of west Bentonville’s most scenic communities, surrounded by rolling hills and wooded views.
Blossom Woods
is located near some of the best outdoor recreation, shopping and dining in Rogers, including Beaver Lake, Lake Atalanta, Hobbs State Park, and Pinnacle Hills Promenade.
Opal Park
is one of southwest Bentonville’s most exciting new communities, featuring thoughtfully designed homes, native landscaping, walking trails, playgrounds and inviting gathering spaces.
The
Fayetteville Design Studio
provides even more design inspiration.

“We are excited to welcome home shoppers to our beautiful new home communities and Design Studio to experience our luxury hospitality and design inspiration firsthand,” said Ted Brock, Division President of Buffington Homes by Toll Brothers in Arkansas. “Whether you are searching for your new dream home or simply love touring beautiful spaces, our 2026 Luxury Home Tour is an event you won’t want to miss.”
and for more information call 479-269-3737 or visit BuffingtonHomesAR.com.
About Toll Brothers

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation’s leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “TOL.” Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine’s 2026 list of the World’s Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
